00220   static bool ugen_isRunningUnderDebugger() throw()
00221   {
00222    static char testResult = 0;
00223    
00224    if (testResult == 0)
00225    {
00226     struct kinfo_proc info;
00227     int m[] = { CTL_KERN, KERN_PROC, KERN_PROC_PID, getpid() };
00228     size_t sz = sizeof (info);
00229     sysctl (m, 4, &info, &sz, 0, 0);
00230     testResult = ((info.kp_proc.p_flag & P_TRACED) != 0) ? 1 : -1;
00231    }
00232    
00233    return testResult > 0;
00234   }
00235 
00236   #define ugen_breakRunningUnderDebugger { if (ugen_isRunningUnderDebugger()) ugen_breakDebugger; }
00237

00239   #define ugen_breakDebugger
00240   #define ugen_breakRunningUnderDebugger
00241  #endif

00287 inline int quantiseUp(const int a, const int q) 
00288 { 
00289  if(a % q)
00290   return a / q * q + q;
00291  else
00292   return a / q * q;
00293 }
00294 
00295 inline int quantiseDown(const int a, const int q) 
00296 { 
00297  return a / q * q; 
00298 }
